description: This file defines a React component for the notes page in a frontend application. It manages displaying, searching, creating, updating, and deleting notes, interacting with authentication and notes state via custom hooks, and rendering a list of notes alongside a note editor.

methods.name: NotesPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the main notes management interface, including notes list, search, and note editor.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates a new empty note and sets it as selected.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves updates to the currently selected note.
